setup.zh: 北上的路到漳水尽了。水是黄的，急的，对岸的城墙在雾里。一个渔人坐在船头，不肯开船。
setup.en: The road north ends at the Zhang. The water is yellow and fast; the far bank's wall stands in the mist. A fisherman sits in the bow and will not cast off.

text.zh: 水底下有什么在呼吸。你听得见。
text.en: Something is breathing under the water. You can hear it.

text.zh: 渔人说：今晚河伯娶妇，谁也不过河。要过，去邺城等明天。
text.en: The fisherman says: tonight the River Lord takes his bride; no one crosses. If you must, go to Ye and wait for morning.

exits.means: goes to the town, follows the road, agrees to wait

text.zh: 你沿岸往北。邺城的城门上贴着一张新告示。
text.en: You follow the bank north. A fresh notice is pasted on the gate of Ye.

exits.means: tries to enter the river, swim, or reach the cauldron now

text.zh: 水没到膝盖就把你往下拽。渔人一把拉你回来。
text.en: The water is at your knees and already pulling you down. The fisherman hauls you back.

text.zh: 从这里下不去。镇上或许有人知道路。
text.en: Not from here. Someone in town may know the way.

exits.means: asks the fisherman about the River Lord, the bride, or the town

text.zh: 渔人压低声音：巫婆年年挑一个姑娘，穿了红衣送下水。河伯收了，一年不发水。
text.en: The fisherman lowers his voice: every year the sorceress picks a girl, dresses her in red and sends her into the water. The River Lord takes her, and the river keeps its banks a year.
